g.text: Down Home Creole · Phase 1 · P1-404 Wrap labeler for round containers (built in house) · rev B
No product contact (container closed): #4 brushed or bead blast; passivate ASTM A967
UNLESS NOTED: LINEAR ±0.5 [±.02] · HOLES +0.2/-0 · ANGLES ±0.5° · MACHINED X.X ±0.1, X.XX ±0.05 · THIRD-ANGLE PROJECTION · BREAK EDGES 0.5 · ASME Y14.5

svg.text: Wrap labeler for round containers P1-404, built in house, 1 off, rev B
Container turns on two driven rollers; one servo-stepper drives the rollers and the liner so the label speed always equals the surface speed
wrap labels on shakers (80 x 190) and jars (100 x 255) after the capper P1-412
ClearPath SDSK NEMA 23 at 24 V, belt 1 to both Ø50 urethane rollers, belt 2 to the Ø30 liner drive; 150 mm/s
3 in core roll ≤ 200 OD, felt brake; peel plate 2 mm, tip R1; O-ring slip rewind; gap fork sensor
lies on the rollers against the UHMW fence (S / J), silicone idler Ø30 on a weighted arm (15 N)
ClearCore: start on arm down, stop at the next gap; FEED, S/J, E-stop, ON/OFF; one 24 V supply
on the bench TBL-2 (top 914 AFF), 4 x M6; footprint 640 x 445; height 450
14 per min one operator (capper 14 per min)
full shop set: matched drive rollers, liner speed locked to the rollers, S/J changeover by 2 screw pairs, controls box on the +x end
SECTION A-A ON THE WEB PATH, BELT DRIVE, S / J SETTINGS
1. Units mm [in]. Third-angle projection. Tolerances in the title block unless noted. Welding (peel bracket only) to AWS D1.6.
2. No product contact: the container is closed and capped. Finish #4 or bead blast, passivated ASTM A967.
3. Cut files (DXF) in dxf/ in mm and inch; 3D: cad/ (STEP per part, P1-404-ASM.step/.glb); generator: design.py, model.py, sh_*.py.
4. Bought parts marked 'confirm' must be checked against the supplier drawing before the matching made part is cut (motor flange, roller shaft ends, box size).
5. Release for build: drawings checked, ITP P1-404-900 attached to the traveler, materials certified, program P1-404-FW-01 loaded.
